exactCanonicalSettings.sourceObservedSetting: clean.screen_app_usage_only: retain aggregation_type == APP_USAGE before cohort union

inputBoundary: Rows from the two raw app-use files before cohort union, with the source aggregation_type and app_name strings unchanged.
outputBoundary: Retain exact APP_USAGE rows except exact YouTube Vanced and Basic Daydreams app names; preserve input order, row identity, and duplicates.
limitations: Matching reproduces dplyr string equality without trimming, normalization, case folding, or whitespace folding; missing predicate values are not retained by filter.
File loading, cohort labels, column renaming, test-participant exclusion, date parsing, grouping, daily sums, unit conversion, and later joins remain outside this component.
The excluded names are applied only to the app_name field after the exact APP_USAGE predicate; this component does not generalize them to other categorical fields.
